style: Iridescent hopper-crystal macro photography: a tangible travelling world of archive creatures, lantern guides, a ferry, mill and parcel automaton.
direction: Jared22Nov: keep the approved unusual art styles and bridge them into something tangible.

artworks.prompt: Create a NEW separate tangible subject for Glaze BISMUTH ANOMALY, using the reference image ONLY for its extraordinary iridescent hopper-crystal material and macro-photographic finish, not its abstract silhouette. Subject: ARCHIVE TORTOISE, a recognizable stout tortoise carrying a compact travelling library grown into its shell. Three-quarter side view facing left. Clear small angular beaked head, four broad short stepped feet, heavy low domed shell. The shell consists of nested terraced metallic bismuth chambers with two tiny recessed book galleries and one squat lookout window, making its role as a walking keeper of archives tangible. Books are small dark slits and stepped spines, no words. The tortoise body and shell are made from crisp right-angle bismuth hopper terraces, iridescent magenta, petrol teal, violet and thin gold rims, NOT smooth biology or glass. Sophisticated real-material macro studio photograph, fine metallic growth striations and angular hollow terraces; surreal constructed creature with a purposeful inhabited world, charming but not cartoon mascot. Strong recognizable tortoise silhouette at widget size, broad horizontal composition contained entirely within central 80 percent of a square canvas. Genuinely transparent alpha background, no ground or baseplate, no cast shadow, no text/logo/border/collage. No abstract zigzag, floating rings, spheres, normal grey rocks, ordinary crystal pile, inflated shape or generic cute animal illustration. Preserve the material's crisp physical identity while making the creature and library instantly understandable.
artworks.export: Original retained; selected artwork fitted whole within 960px on a 1024px transparent square. Wallpaper unchanged.
